selectedCaptureReview.review: Blast frame: fixed 0 m marker and displaced APC; courier exposed.
Parking fix: intact APC aligned with boarding destination; cover wording is still the old version.
Courier already driving while HUD shows 5/25 aboard and 20 waiting; enemy pressure reaches the queue.
Cover fix: armed courier on foot, 15/22 aboard, 7 waiting; intact APC and recognizable corpses.
Fresh high: courier armed at APC, 10/11 aboard with one waiting, blast/debris visible and intact wheels/hull. Controls/Sound strip is the QA debug selector UI.
Actual progressed low: 15/24 aboard, nine waiting; armed courier clearly visible at fixed marker, intact APC and orderly queue behind it.
